# stack-lib
A minimal stack data structure library with push, pop, and peek operations. Guarantees LIFO ordering and safe behavior on empty stacks.

# int-utils
Small integer utilities: absolute value, min/max of a list, integer square root, and greatest common divisor. Focus on correctness for edge cases like zero and negative inputs.

# string-tools
String helpers: reverse, palindrome check, character counting, and substring search. Simple implementations meant for teaching.

# sorted-list
An always-sorted list with insert and remove. Maintains ordering invariants on every operation.

# queue-ring
A fixed-capacity ring buffer queue with enqueue, dequeue, and full/empty tracking.

# uart-lite
A minimal UART transmitter/receiver with configurable baud rate. Tracks start bit, data bits, and stop bit phases; flags framing errors when the stop bit is missing.

# dma-copier
A simple DMA engine that copies a block of words from a source to a destination address. Tracks words remaining and raises done exactly when the count reaches zero.

# rr-arbiter
Round-robin arbiter for four requesters sharing one resource, rotating a priority pointer after each grant so service stays fair.

# pwm-dimmer
PWM generator for LED dimming: an 8-bit duty cycle compared against a free-running counter to shape the output waveform.

# watchdog
Watchdog timer that must be kicked before the countdown expires, otherwise it asserts a system reset. The reset stays latched until acknowledged.

# crc8-check
Streaming CRC-8 checksum over a byte stream, one bit per cycle. The remainder register must always equal the polynomial reduction of the bits consumed so far.

# debounce
Button debouncer: the output only changes after the raw input has been stable for N consecutive samples. A saturating stability counter drives the decision.

# traffic-light
Two-road intersection controller cycling green, yellow, red with a timer per phase and an all-red interval between handovers.

# elevator-ctrl
Single-cab elevator controller for a four-floor building: current floor register, direction flag, pending request bitmap, one floor of travel per step.

# vending-fsm
Vending machine accepting 5c and 10c coins toward a 25c item: credit accumulator, dispense pulse, and change calculation.

# thermo-hyst
Thermostat with hysteresis: the heater turns on below t_low and off above t_high, never chattering in between. The on/off state and the temperature comparison must stay consistent.

# gray-counter
Gray-code counter for clock-domain crossing: successive values differ in exactly one bit. Keeps a shadow binary counter internally to derive the gray value.

# lfsr-rng
Maximal-length 8-bit LFSR pseudo-random generator with taps at the polynomial positions, stepped once per enable.

# token-bucket
Token-bucket rate limiter for outbound requests: tokens drip in at a fixed rate, each grant spends one, and requests stall while the bucket is dry.

# chess-clock
Two-player chess clock: exactly one side's timer decrements at a time, toggled by a button press, frozen when either side reaches zero.

# nano-alu
An 8-bit ALU slice supporting add, subtract, and, or, with carry and zero flags, and a registered result.

# barrel-shifter
Barrel shifter that rotates a 16-bit word by a variable amount in one cycle, built from staged shift-by-1/2/4/8 layers.

# prio-encoder
Priority encoder over an 8-bit request vector: reports the index of the highest set bit plus a valid flag, with a registered output stage.
